stories.label: Iran war Day 9+: 787+ killed, 6 US soldiers dead at Kuwait base, ground assault on Lebanon
stories.summary: Day 9: Death toll 787+ (Red Crescent). 6 US soldiers killed at Camp Arifjan — first US military casualties. US fighter jet downed by Kuwaiti friendly fire. IAEA confirms fresh damage at Natanz. Trump says 4-5 weeks. Congress war powers vote still pending.

stories.label: Hormuz closed: 400,000 tons of Indian rice stranded, oil spiked 13%
stories.summary: Hormuz still closed. 750+ ships backed up. 400,000 tons Indian basmati rice stranded at ports — Gulf states import 85-90% of calories. Oil spiked 13%. European gas doubled. Qatar LNG halted. South Korea securing alternative oil supply routes.

stories.label: Israel launches ground assault in Lebanon — 52 killed, Hezbollah retaliates
stories.summary: Israel deployed ground troops 'deeper into southern Lebanon' beyond 5-point border zone. 52 killed across Lebanon on Monday. Hezbollah hit 3 Israeli bases with drones. Lebanon president declared Hezbollah ban 'irreversible.' Full ground occupation developing.

stories.label: US Marines fire on Karachi protesters — Pakistan destabilizing
stories.summary: US Marines opened fire on Pakistani protesters who stormed the Karachi consulate. At least 10 killed. US suspended all visa appointments across Pakistan. Pro-Iran protests, IMF dependency, Afghan border war — triple crisis in a nuclear state.

stories.label: Russian strikes hit 3-year peak — 288 missiles in February
stories.summary: 288 overnight missiles in February — highest in 3 years. Russia escalating while Iran war consumes global attention. Peace talks expected March. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Milei's legislative blitz: labour reform, criminal age lowered, glacier law weakened
stories.summary: Labour reform passed, criminal age lowered to 14, glacier protections weakened — all in one week. Unions filed constitutional challenge. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: US opens chip door for Vietnam, locks it on China
stories.summary: Washington lifts export controls on Vietnam. Strategic chip supply chain shift to Southeast Asia. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Ultra-sensitive CAR T cells eliminate hard-to-treat tumours
stories.summary: Engineered immune cells detect and destroy tumours that evade conventional immunotherapy. Mouse study. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Super agers' brains keep producing new neurons into their 80s
stories.summary: People over 80 who remain mentally sharp generate new hippocampal neurons at rates comparable to younger people. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Meta smart glasses workers can see everything wearers see
stories.summary: Workers processing Meta smart glasses data can see everything wearers see. Human surveillance behind 'AI' features. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Russia to block Telegram in April — 100M+ users
stories.summary: Kremlin says decision is 'final.' Last major channel for anti-war organizing and independent news. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: British lawyers to sue UAE and RSF leaders in UK courts for Sudan war crimes
stories.summary: Sudanese Bar Association announced UK lawyers will file lawsuits in British courts against UAE and RSF leaders for war crimes. First legal accountability attempt for Sudan in Western courts.

stories.label: Earth's oldest crystals suggest plate tectonics started 4.4 billion years ago
stories.summary: Analysis of 4.4-billion-year-old zircon crystals from Western Australia suggests plate tectonics began far earlier than the accepted 3-billion-year timeline. Rewrites Earth's geological history.

stories.label: Half of nations meet UN biodiversity reporting deadline
stories.summary: First major test of 2022 Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. Half of nations submitted plans by deadline. Many plans more ambitious than expected, but major biodiversity-rich nations missing.

stories.label: Motorola partners with GrapheneOS for privacy-first enterprise phones
stories.summary: First mainstream phone manufacturer to ship GrapheneOS. Announced at MWC 2026. Legitimizes privacy OS movement — previously required manual installation on Pixel devices.

stories.label: AI disinformation floods Nepal's first post-protest election
stories.summary: Nepal's March 5 election being flooded with deepfakes and AI-generated disinformation. Parties targeting young voters who drove last year's uprising. Shows AI disinformation is now a Global South problem.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: interim council active, succession race underway
stories.summary: Interim council leading Iran. Succession crisis ongoing amid active war. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Iran civilian death toll 787+, school strike 180+ killed
stories.summary: Death toll now 787+ (Red Crescent count). School strike toll 180+. 153 cities affected. War crimes evidence mounting.

stories.label: Most Americans oppose Iran war — Congress to debate war powers
stories.summary: Only 25% of Americans approve strikes. Congress war powers vote still pending. US soldier deaths may shift this further.

stories.label: Macron expands France's nuclear arsenal, offers nuclear aircraft to allies
stories.summary: France expanding nuclear arsenal and offering nuclear-armed aircraft to allies. France deploying fighter jets over UAE. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: crossings closed, Al-Aqsa shut, aid halted under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Total siege continues. All crossings sealed. 37 aid orgs halted. Al-Aqsa shut during Ramadan. Iran war providing cover. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: US Treasury drops Claude after Anthropic rejected Pentagon AI demands
stories.summary: US Treasury ended all Anthropic/Claude use. OpenAI took the deal. AI used in Iran strikes. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC — US sanctions Rwanda's military
stories.summary: US sanctioned Rwanda's army chief. Mass graves near Uvira. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Nepal's first post-protest election March 5 — AI disinformation surge
stories.summary: Nepal votes March 5. New protest-born parties vs old guard. 3,400+ candidates, 30% under 40. AI deepfakes flooding social media targeting young voters.

stories.label: India-Canada nuclear energy deal resets ties
stories.summary: Canada-India nuclear energy deal including uranium supply. Dramatic reversal after Nijjar assassination fallout. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: 170+ killed in South Sudan's Ruweng — MSF staff missing
stories.summary: ~170 killed in single attack. MSF staff missing. UN warns of return to civil war. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Sudan war — fading from global attention
stories.summary: Crisis continues. UK court lawsuits may revive attention. Iran war consuming all bandwidth.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — attention pulled by Iran war
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts. Iran war diverting attention.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border war
stories.summary: Fighting continuing. No signs of de-escalation. Part of broader Pakistan destabilization.

stories.label: Prediction markets: war death bets, suspected insider trading
stories.summary: Kalshi and Polymarket hosting war death bets. Nasdaq joining binary bets market. $1.2M insider trading suspected. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: El Niño may return in 2026
stories.summary: El Niño forecast. Would make hottest period ever hotter. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: AWS data centers in Dubai destroyed by Iranian missiles
stories.summary: Amazon confirms drones damaged three facilities in UAE and Bahrain. First time major cloud infrastructure physically destroyed by warfare. Not covered this cycle.
